title: Massively Parallel Huffman Decoding on GPUs
key_contribution: First massively parallel Huffman decoder compatible with original Huffman codes, exploiting self-synchronization property on CUDA GPUs. Over 10x speedup vs CPU Zstandard Huffman decoder.

title: Massively-Parallel Lossless Data Decompression
key_contribution: Two techniques for parallel DEFLATE decompression: GPU/SIMD parallelism within blocks and modified format to eliminate data dependencies. 2x speedup over multi-core CPU baselines with 17% energy saving.

title: Rapidgzip: Parallel Decompression and Seeking in Gzip Files Using Cache Prefetching
key_contribution: Generalized parallel gzip decompression removing pugz's ASCII restriction via cache-based architecture. 8.7 GB/s with 128 cores (55x over GNU gzip) on base64 data, 5.6 GB/s on Silesia.

title: Asymmetric numeral systems: entropy coding combining speed of Huffman coding with compression rate of arithmetic coding
key_contribution: Foundational ANS paper. ANS achieves arithmetic coding compression ratio at Huffman-like speed. 50% faster decoding than HC for 256-symbol alphabet. Enables tANS/rANS variants used in Zstandard, LZFSE, JPEG XL.

title: The use of asymmetric numeral systems as an accurate replacement for Huffman coding
key_contribution: Practical comparison of ANS vs Huffman coding showing ANS achieves near-arithmetic coding compression with Huffman-like throughput. Establishes ANS as viable Huffman replacement.

title: An Architecture for Asymmetric Numeral Systems Entropy Decoder - A Comparison with a Canonical Huffman Decoder
key_contribution: Hardware architecture comparison of ANS vs canonical Huffman decoder. Provides detailed cycle-level analysis of both approaches for FPGA implementation.

title: Large-Alphabet Semi-Static Entropy Coding Via Asymmetric Numeral Systems
key_contribution: Extends ANS to large alphabets (thousands/millions of symbols). Demonstrates ANS provides excellent balance between compression effectiveness and speed for semi-static compression.

title: Design and Evaluation of an FPGA-based Hardware Accelerator for Deflate Data Decompression
key_contribution: FPGA Deflate decompressor using HLS. Achieves 70.7 MB/s input (246.4 MB/s output) for dynamic blocks and 130.6 MB/s input (386.6 MB/s output) for static blocks on Xilinx Virtex UltraScale+.

title: High-Throughput FPGA-Based Hardware Accelerators for Deflate Compression and Decompression Using High-Level Synthesis
key_contribution: FPGA Deflate compressor at 4.0 GB/s fixed input throughput with 1.92 compression ratio. Decompressor at 196.61 MB/s for static encoding. First HLS-based decompressor comparable to expert-optimized designs.

title: MetaZip: A High-throughput and Efficient Accelerator for DEFLATE
key_contribution: FPGA DEFLATE compressor achieving 15.6 GB/s with single engine (234x over CPU gzip). Adaptive parallel-width pipeline fed 64 bytes/cycle. Targets FPGA-enabled data centers.

title: A 43.3 bit/cycle Inflate Accelerator Featuring Static-Dynamic Huffman Decoder with Multiple Checkpoints
key_contribution: Hardware inflate accelerator at 43.3 bits/cycle using speculative Huffman decoder with multiple checkpoints and optimized end-of-block control. Addresses data dependency challenge with parallel speculative threading.

title: Efficiency of ANS Entropy Encoders
key_contribution: Optimal bounds for tANS redundancy. Shows redundancy is O(sigma/n) bits/symbol, refuting Duda's O(sigma/n^2) conjecture. Proposes rANS variant avoiding slow division operations.

title: A Review of the Asymmetric Numeral System and Its Applications to Digital Images
key_contribution: Comprehensive ANS review covering tANS, rANS, and applications. Documents ANS adoption in JPEG XL, Zstandard, LZFSE. Analyzes chaotic properties for simultaneous compression-encryption.

title: Decode efficient prefix codes
key_contribution: Theoretical analysis of prefix code decode efficiency. Relevant to understanding fundamental limits of Huffman decode throughput.

title: A Highly Scalable Parallel Design for Data Compression
key_contribution: Novel parallel compression/decompression with dynamic threading and random access points. Demonstrates massive speedups on AMD Zen-based high core-count processors while maintaining format compliance.

title: Dual-Thread Deflate/Inflate Accelerator With Multicheckpoint Control
key_contribution: Dual-thread hardware inflate accelerator with multi-checkpoint speculative Huffman decoding for high throughput while maintaining compatibility.

title: Lossless Decompression Accelerator for Embedded Processor with GUI
key_contribution: Hardware LZ77 decompression + static Huffman decoding accelerator for embedded processors. 20.7 MB/s at 50 MHz on FPGA.

title: Accelerating Relative-error Bounded Lossy Compression for HPC datasets with Precomputation-Based Mechanisms
key_contribution: Fast table lookup for Huffman decoding in SZ compressor. Reduces traversing operations for Huffman decode, improving decompression by ~70%. Demonstrates precomputation-based speedup approach.

title: A Novel ANS Coding with Low Computational Complexity
key_contribution: ANS variant combining truncated binary coding to avoid multiplication/division operations entirely. 1.1% compression loss for significant computational savings.

title: Investigations on algorithm selection for interval-based coding methods
key_contribution: Systematic comparison of AC, range coding, and ANS with focus on decoder speed. Shows binary indexing method superior for adaptive compression. Detailed complexity analysis of interval-based coders.

title: Lightweight Compression with Encryption Based on Asymmetric Numeral Systems
key_contribution: Demonstrates ANS table perturbation for simultaneous compression and encryption at near-zero cost. Relevant to understanding ANS's flexibility for custom decode paths.

title: The Library for Hadoop Deflate Compression Based on FPGA Accelerator with Load Balance
key_contribution: Multi-FPGA DEFLATE compression for Hadoop. 6.55x speedup (single FPGA) to 10.24x (dual FPGA) for zpipe, 3.25x for Terasort. Demonstrates FPGA DEFLATE acceleration at system level.

title: pugz: Parallel decompression of gzipped text files
key_contribution: First parallel gzip decompressor exploiting probabilistic block boundary detection. Restriction to ASCII text (bytes 9-126). Demonstrated feasibility of speculative DEFLATE block parallelism.

title: Entropy decoding in Oodle Data: x86-64 6-stream Huffman decoders
key_contribution: Detailed microarchitectural analysis of 6-stream interleaved Huffman decode. 4 instructions/symbol, 1.83 cycles/symbol on Skylake (3+ GB/s). Demonstrates throughput-bound Huffman decode with sufficient ILP.

title: ISA-L Igzip: Improvements to a Fast Deflate
key_contribution: Intel ISA-L igzip optimizations including hand-written assembly, AVX2 string matching, optimized Huffman decode tables. Establishes ISA-L as one of the fastest DEFLATE implementations.
